core.description: Pure headless engine. No DOM/Worker deps. No imports from outer layers.

render.description: WebGL2 renderer. Reads core via read-only views; never mutates core.

headless.description: Node CLI for batch runs / experiments.

lenia3d.description: 3D creatures-as-Lenia rebuild (own world+renderer+entry). Self-contained vertical slice; imports only core/rng for determinism. Separate from the 2D core/render/app layers.

notes: ESLint (eslint.config.js) is the CI-enforced layer for import direction and ambient DOM/Worker globals; this file documents intent for the architecture-guard skill.
